stages.headline: Many equations become quadratics after a substitution: 2sin²x − sin x − 1 = 0 ⇒ t = sin x, 2t² − t − 1 = 0 ⇒ sin x = 1 or sin x = −1/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: Many equations become quadratics after a substitution: 2sin²x − sin x − 1 = 0 ⇒ t = sin x, 2t² − t − 1 = 0 ⇒ sin x = 1 or sin x = −1/2.

stages.headline: Factoring: sin 2x = cos x ⇒ cos x(2 sin x − 1) = 0 ⇒ cos x = 0 or sin x = 1/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: Factoring: sin 2x = cos x ⇒ cos x(2 sin x − 1) = 0 ⇒ cos x = 0 or sin x = 1/2.

stages.headline: Homogeneous equation: sin x = √3 cos x; divide by cos x ≠ 0: tg x = √3 ⇒ x = π/3 + πk.
